'''Lugjack''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|game of chance]] popular in many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. A lugjack machine was a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]]-operated stand-alone device with three or more reels that rotated when a player pulled a lever located on the side of the machine. It typically paid off based on patterns of symbols visible on the front of the machine when it stopped.

The [[Tralla Room]] on the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' had a range of lugjack bars,<ref name="DFR" /> and the [[Casino Kuari]] on board the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] had lugjack among its games.<ref name="RM" />
